policy: Frozen within-category queue from fresh holdout authors only, sort previously unused IDs then prefer uploaders absent from primary test. Attempt interleaved groups until per-class target, fixed cap 100/class, or eligible queue exhausted. Skip unavailable/mismatched Creative Commons pages, non-stereo, clips shorter than 4.9s, near-dual-mono or repeated source audio. Disclose overlap of all shared recording IDs and uploaders with primary holdout.
